scheme_name: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Student for Studies in India
other_conditions: Applicant must be a national of India.
Applicant must permanently reside in Haryana.
Applicant must belong to the lower‑income group as defined under the scheme guidelines.
Applicant must have passed the matriculation or equivalent examination from a recognized board or university.
Applicant must be enrolled in a recognized post‑matriculation course (e.g., National Fire Service College, Aircraft Maintenance Engineer's Course, Training Ship Dufferin, Military College, etc.).
Students in Class XI/XII under continuous school courses are ineligible unless the 10th class is equivalent to matriculation.
benefits_summary: Provides monthly maintenance allowances, tuition fee coverage and other reimbursements for post‑matriculation students from lower‑income groups.
